Q: How do I integrate nursing models like Gibbs Reflective Cycle?

When applying the Gibbs Reflective Cycle to your nursing assignment, ensure that your reflection is organized into the following six sections:

  • Description – Describe the clinical event.
  • Feelings – Speak of how you felt.
  • Evaluation – What worked and what did not?
  • Analysis – This is the part where you relate evidence with the experience.
  • Conclusion – You may talk about what you have learned.
  • Action Plan – How are you going to do better?

This structure should be used for assignments where professional development, patient communication, or ethical decision-making is assessed. https://nigerianlawyerscenter.com/
